text:
perf-bot: nightly-ci: small-batch throughput regressed ~12% on master (job: https://ci.redwood.com/job/nightly-small-batch/21678055)

sasha.m: heads-up runtime — perf-bot is noisy this morning, flagged a regression after the PR merge window. cc @kevin.t @maria.g

kevin.t: on it. which commit window does the job annotate?

perf-bot: affected range: commits 8a3f2d4..b9c1f07, culprit_candidate: unknown, artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood.com/nightly/21678055

maria.g: can we reproduce locally with the small-batch harness? i can kick off the repro on a dev rig. command:```./infra/bench/run_small_batch.sh --model gpt-medium --seq 512 --batch 4 --iters 200 --collect-flamegraph```

kevin.t: starting a bisect run across that range on a few machines now. i'll parallelize to save time, will post deltas once each job finishes.

jon.r: fyi i skimmed the perf trace from the artifact — allocation wait spikes around token 120 for many requests, flamegraphs attached in the artifact show more time in mempool::free_path compared to baseline. :eyes:

arjun.k: that sounds like my changes from yesterday (slab/mempool tweak). i didn't touch the allocator fast-path but did tweak free accounting. i'll stand by to revert if bisect points at my commit.

kevin.t: bisect first pass done — commit b9c1f07 (arjun.k) correlates with the 11-13% regression across three runners. opening a quick revert PR to validate.

maria.g: while revert PR is in flight, i'll run the flamegraph repro with --heap-trace to double-check contention points. path to flamegraph uploader: https://perf.redwood.com/upload

ops-bot: PR opened by kevin.t -> https://git.redwood.com/r/redwood/runtime/pull/4201 (revert: mempool accounting change)

arjun.k: thanks — i'll run unit + microbench locally and see if i can reproduce the alloc spikes. if i can, i'll push a fix rather than revert later.

kevin.t: landed revert PR 4201 (CI pending). rolling nightly back to last-green in the queue to unblock.

maria.g: re-run complete against revert tip — throughput back within 0.8% of baseline on dev rig. flamegraph shows mempool free time reduced to expected levels. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: alert resolved for job 21678055 (status: recovered), regression delta now 0.8%

sasha.m: thanks team. action items: (1) short postmortem tomorrow — include reproducer and flamegraphs (assign kevin.t + arjun.k), (2) add small-batch microbench to PR gating for allocator changes, (3) improve perf-bot alert to include top-5 stack traces in future. i'll file the follow-ups.

kevin.t: created incident-ish ticket #IR-287 (https://tickets.redwood.com/IR-287) and added initial notes + artifacts. tagging @eng-runtime for visibility.

jon.r: leaving a note to add a quick smoke-run job that exercises the small-batch path under mempool stress during pre-merge CI.

arjun.k: will follow up with a targeted fix and tests before I re-land the change. thanks for the quick triage.

sasha.m: closing thread here — shout if anything pops back up overnight. :white_check_mark:
